relationships.subject: NF-kB
relationships.evidence_quote: Both pathways converge on NF-κB and drive the transcription of TNF-α, IL-6, MCP-1, COX-2 and iNOS.

relationships.subject: COX-2
relationships.evidence_quote: COX-2 catalyzes the conversion of arachidonic acid to PGE2, which sensitizes peripheral nociceptors via EP1/EP4 receptors

relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: triggers NLRP3 oligomerization, ASC recruitment and Caspase-1 autocleavage, leading to the maturation of IL-1β, IL-18 and GSDMD

relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: IL-1β, IL-6 and TNF-α act on dorsal root ganglion neurons to upregulate TRPV1 expression and phosphorylation

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: MyD88 then recruits IRAK4/1–TRAF6, ultimately activating IκB kinase and NF-κB (29)

key_findings: Review proposes a Metabolic-Immune-Neural triangle linking adipose inflammation (TLR4/RAGE-NF-kB, NLRP3) to DRG TRPV1 sensitization and chronic pain.
